observations.title: feature-flags now discloses the telemetry kill-switch state to any authenticated user
observations.detail: telemetry_sharing_hard_disabled reveals whether DO_NOT_TRACK / TELEMETRY_SHARING_ENABLED is off. Previously visible to admins only (the Settings panel). A boolean about telemetry configuration, no credential, no PII; the flag is what lets the consent card stay hidden without an admin round-trip. Below the daily gate; recorded so the choice is visible.

observations.title: feature-flags discloses whether the install ever completed an autonomous run
observations.detail: telemetry_sharing_first_value is derived from schedule_executions (any SUCCESS with trigger schedule/webhook). Any authenticated user already sees executions they can access; a fleet-level boolean adds nothing exploitable.
